title: Tandoori Chicken Wraps with Cucumber Raita
summary: Juicy, spiced tandoori-style chicken is wrapped in soft tortillas with crisp salad and a cooling cucumber yogurt raita. A satisfying Indian-inspired lunch with smoky spices, freshness and a little heat.

ingredients.name: cucumber, coarsely grated and squeezed dry

steps: Mix the marinade yogurt, lemon juice, garlic, ginger, paprika, cumin, ground coriander, turmeric, chilli powder and salt in a bowl. Add the chicken strips and turn until well coated; leave to marinate for 10 minutes while you prepare the raita, or up to several hours if you have time.
For the cucumber raita, stir together the yogurt, grated cucumber, mint, cumin and black pepper. Taste and add a small pinch of salt if needed, then chill until ready to serve.

Heat the vegetable oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Add the marinated chicken in a single layer, cooking in batches if necessary, and fry for 8–10 minutes, turning occasionally, until lightly charred at the edges and cooked through with no pink remaining.
Warm the flour tortillas in a dry pan for about 20 seconds per side, or until soft and pliable.
Spread a spoonful of cucumber raita over each tortilla. Add shredded lettuce, red onion and the hot tandoori chicken, then spoon over a little more raita.
Fold in the sides and roll each tortilla tightly into a wrap. Serve immediately while the chicken is warm and the raita is cool.
